AHD.ATTACK: Attack ramp time, 0-10 s; ramp curve is shaped by dragging the line.
AHD.HOLD: Time the envelope stays at peak before decaying, 0-10 s.
AHD.DECAY: Decay ramp time, 0-30 s; ramp curve is shaped by dragging the line.
AHD.VEL. AMOUNT: How much note velocity affects the envelope, 0-100 %.
AHD.VEL. SENS: Velocity response curve, +/-100 %; sets how velocity is remapped.

Analog ADSR.DECAY: Decay time, 0.0001-10 s; analog-style decay character.
Analog ADSR.SUSTAIN: Sustain level, 0-100 %; ignored in AD mode.
Analog ADSR.RELEASE: Release time after note-off, 0.0001-10 s; ignored in AD mode.
Analog ADSR.DYNAMIC: Output range controlled by velocity, 0-40 dB; always follows played velocity.
Analog ADSR.PUNCH: Overshoots attack target, creating a flat plateau at peak, 0-100 %.
Analog ADSR.ATTACK/DECAY: Envelope mode: AD (attack and decay only) or ADSR (all phases).
Analog ADSR.TRIGGER: Manual button to fire the envelope on demand; also automatable.
Analog ADSR.VELOCITY: Button that inverts velocity for the attack and decay velocity controls only.

Attack Decay.ATTACK: Attack as a percentage of decay time, 0-100 %; internally clamped to 1-99 %.

DAHDSR.DELAY: Pause before the attack starts, 0-10 s.
DAHDSR.HOLD: Time held at peak before decay, 0-10 s.
DAHDSR.RELEASE CURVE: Release shape, -1 to 1: 0 is straight, negative is concave, positive is convex.
DAHDSR.VEL. AMOUNT: How much velocity affects the envelope, 0-100 %; 0 disables it.
DAHDSR.VEL. SENS: Velocity curve, +/-100 %: positive is exponential, negative is logarithmic.

Data Envelope.EXTRACT METHOD: RMS (average level), PEAK, BRIGHTNESS, or PITCH; RMS/PEAK/BRIGHTNESS are unidirectional, PITCH is bipolar.
Data Envelope.SPEED: Playback rate relative to original audio, 0.1-10; below 1 stretches, above 1 compresses.
Data Envelope.SMOOTH: Rounds off abrupt data jumps, 0-1 s; most useful on pitch and brightness.
Data Envelope.LOOP: Off (play once), Continuous (repeat loop while held), or Sustain (loop stops at note-off).

Drunk.INITIAL VALUE: Starting point of the random walk, -1 to 1.
Drunk.SMOOTH: Amount of smoothing applied to value changes, 0.1-1000 Hz.
Drunk.BIAS: Weights movement up or down, -1 to 1.
Drunk.BIPOLAR: On gives a range both sides of the start value; off gives one direction only.

Flow Noise.RANDOMSTART: Random start position after each trigger, on or off.
Flow Noise.BIPOLAR: Range is -1 to +1 when on, or 0 to +1 when off.
Flow Noise.TRIGGER MODE: Retrigger (restart same stream), Legato (shared start for concurrent triggers), or No Retrigger (runs continuously).

LFO.WAVEFORM: Sine, Square, Triangle, Ramp Up, Ramp Down, Analog Square, Random Sample & Hold, Chaos Lorenz, Chaos Rossler, or User.
LFO.FREQ: Cycle rate, 0-20 Hz; with tempo sync, 32 bars down to 64th-note triplet.
LFO.TEMPO SYNC: Locks cycle duration to Falcon's tempo instead of Hz.
LFO.PHASE: Point in the cycle where the LFO starts when triggered, 0-1.
LFO.DELAY: Time between trigger and LFO start, 0-10 s.
LFO.RISE: Time for depth to ramp up to full range, 0-10 s.
LFO.SMOOTH: Smooths transitions between cycle values, 0-1 s.
LFO.TRIGGER MODE: Retrigger, Legato, No Retrigger, or Song (synced to host bar/beat position).
LFO.MANUAL TRIGGER: Restarts the cycle on demand when value passes 0.5, 0-1.
LFO.BIPOLAR: Range is -1 to +1 when on (default), or 0 to +1 when off.

Macro.VALUE: Value sent to assigned controls when adjusted, 0-100 %.
Macro.STYLE: Continuous (variable knob) or On/Off (two-state toggle) on the Info tab.
Macro.BIPOLAR: Range is -100 % to +100 % when on, or 0-100 % when off (default).

Multi Envelope.SPEED: Time factor; 1.0 follows the grid, higher values play faster, lower slower.
Multi Envelope.VEL. AMOUNT: How much velocity affects the envelope, 0-100 %.
Multi Envelope.BIPOLAR: Range is 0 to +1 (default); enabling it gives -1 to +1 and rescales point levels.
Multi Envelope.RELEASE LOOPED: When on, the loop continues after note-off; when off, a release point after the loop end is used.
Multi Envelope.POINTS: Up to 128 editable points; edited graphically, with no sliders.

Multi LFO.FREQUENCY: Cycle duration; tempo-synced 32 bars to 64th triplet, or Hz up to 20 Hz.
Multi LFO.TEMPO SYNC: Syncs cycle duration to Falcon's tempo instead of Hz.
Multi LFO.PHASE: Point in the cycle where the LFO starts when triggered, 0-1.
Multi LFO.RISE TIME: Time for depth to ramp up to full range, 0-10 s.
Multi LFO.SINE: Sine contribution to the composite waveform, +/-100 %.
Multi LFO.TRIANGLE: Triangle contribution to the composite waveform, +/-100 %.
Multi LFO.SQUARE: Square contribution to the composite waveform, +/-100 %.
Multi LFO.SAW: Sawtooth contribution to the composite waveform, +/-100 %.
Multi LFO.BIPOLAR: Range is -1 to +1 (default), or 0 to +1 when off.
Multi LFO.INVERT: Flips the composite waveform polarity before unipolar conversion.
Multi LFO.NORMALIZED: Rescales the composite waveform to stay within output range.
Multi LFO.SMOOTH: Smooths transitions in the composite waveform, 0-1 s.
Multi LFO.TRIGGER MODE: Retrigger, Legato, No Retrigger, or Song (host bar/beat sync).
Multi LFO.MANUAL TRIGGER: Restarts the cycle on demand when value passes 0.5, 0-1.

Parametric LFO.FREQ: Cycle duration; tempo-synced 32 bars to 64th triplet, or Hz up to 50 Hz.
Parametric LFO.TEMPO SYNC: Syncs cycle duration to Falcon's tempo instead of Hz.
Parametric LFO.PHASE: Start point within the cycle when triggered, -1 to 1.
Parametric LFO.SHAPE: Morphs from flat line (-100 %) through triangle (0 %) to square (+100 %).
Parametric LFO.SYMMETRY: Balance between rising and falling halves, +/-100 %.
Parametric LFO.BIPOLAR: Range is -1 to +1 (default), or 0 to +1 when off.
Parametric LFO.TRIGGER MODE: Retrigger, Legato, No Retrigger, or Song (host bar/beat sync).

Script Event Modulation.EVENT ID: Identifier the modulator listens on; must match the script's sent ID, 0-127.
Script Event Modulation.BIPOLAR: Output is -1 to +1 (default), or 0 to +1 when off.

Smooth Random.RATE: Modulation speed, 0-1000 Hz; 0 Hz holds the current value.
Smooth Random.RANDOMSTART: Random start position after each trigger, on or off.
Smooth Random.BIPOLAR: Range is -1 to +1 when on, or 0 to +1 when off.

Step Envelope.STEPS: Number of steps in the sequence, 1-128.
Step Envelope.FREQ: Rate of advancing between steps, 0-20 Hz; tempo-synced 32 bars to 64th triplet.
Step Envelope.TEMPO SYNC: Syncs step duration to Falcon's tempo instead of Hz.
Step Envelope.BIPOLAR: Step range is 0 to +1 (default), or -1 to +1 when on.
Step Envelope.DEPTH: Scales all step levels together, 0-100 %; at 0 the output is silent.
Step Envelope.INTERPOLATION MODE: Hold (instant jump per step) or Spline (smooth curve between steps).
Step Envelope.MANUAL TRIGGER: Restarts the sequence from step one when value passes 0.5, 0-1.
Step Envelope.SMOOTH: Smoothing applied to each step, 0-1 s.

Voice Modulator.NUMSTEPS: Number of steps in the sequence, 1-16.
Voice Modulator.LEGATO: OFF advances one step per new note; ON restarts from step one when a note is played on an empty hold.

_general.bipolar_unipolar: Many modulators default to bipolar (-1 to +1); disabling BIPOLAR gives unipolar (0 to +1). Macros default to unipolar 0-100 %.
_general.depth_scaling: DEPTH (0-100 %) scales modulation output; velocity and key-follow amounts are percentages, with key follow up to +/-200 %.
